envoy.label: Send gifts
envoy.description: An envoy carries gifts. Their opinion of you rises (less so the more they already like you).

trade.label: Propose trade agreement
trade.description: Both sides earn wealth every day, more for each district where your borders touch and each Market you own. Needs a connection: your territories must touch, or you both need a Market.

pact.label: Propose non-aggression pact
pact.description: Neither side can raid, agitate against or declare war on the other while it holds. You can pay in wealth, food or materials.

alliance.label: Propose defensive alliance
alliance.description: If either of you is attacked, the other joins the war. Includes a non-aggression pact.

vassalage.label: Demand submission
vassalage.description: A much weaker faction (under 40% of your strength) accepts your protection and becomes your tributary: it pays you 20% of its food, materials and wealth, makes no diplomacy but trade, starts no wars, and joins yours with half its force. Factions that don't feel threatened value their independence.

integrate.label: Vassalize tributary
integrate.description: Take a loyal tributary of at least a year into your faction: its land, people and stores become yours. Costs more for bigger tributaries.

match.label: Propose a match
match.proposal: a match between your families (one of yours would marry into theirs and leave you)
match.description: One of your unmarried grown family marries one of theirs (family or a house), who joins your family. While both live the families are bound: each side thinks better of the other (+20), pacts, alliances and backing come easier, and pressing a claim on them breaks your word.

backing.label: Ask them to back your claim
backing.proposal: that you back the claim they're pressing (see their card)
backing.description: Ask them to stand behind the claim you're pressing. If they agree, their strength counts with yours: the target is likelier to give in, you can send the ultimatum sooner, and they join the war if it comes. Likelier if they like you, dislike your target, or are your ally.

tribute.label: Pay tribute
tribute.description: Hand over food or materials (whichever you can better spare) and they leave you alone for 60 days. They always take it. Raid or attack them while it holds and the deal is off. Only for a faction that raided you or demanded tribute in the last 90 days; the price grows with their strength.

demand.label: Demand tribute
demand.proposal: that you pay tribute or be raided
demand.description: Tell a neighbour to pay you food or materials. If they pay, you promise not to raid them for 60 days. If they refuse, your raids on them get +20% odds for 60 days. Weaker factions give in more easily.
